summary_1line: Bhishma praises sacred names and Savitri mantras for protection and merit, then answers Yudhishthira that Brahmanas deserve highest reverence.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Bhagiratha stands in penance as the celestial river Ganga descends from heaven through Shiva’s matted hair to flow upon the earth.
The sacred waters of the Ganga wash over the ashes of Sagara’s sixty thousand sons, granting them liberation.
Bhishma lies upon his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him asking who deserves worship.
